objective: Ensure global information sources, intelligence-center tools, compute-center tools, and incumbent capability changes are discovered promptly, evaluated against existing capabilities, and upgraded safely under zero-cost-first constraints.
truthfulness: This policy targets measurable high coverage and bounded detection latency. It does not claim literal complete or zero-blind-spot coverage.

timeliness_slo.critical_security_or_service_change: detect within 24 hours when an official machine-readable feed exists
timeliness_slo.new_release_or_deprecation: detect within 72 hours for approved tools with official release feeds or registry metadata
timeliness_slo.pricing_license_or_free_tier_change: detect within 7 days where an official page or feed can be monitored
timeliness_slo.new_high_value_tool_or_source: enter candidate registry within 7 days when present in a covered registry; otherwise within the next scheduled multilingual discovery cycle

required_steps: map the new request or candidate to capability IDs
check whether an existing API, MCP, connector, package, model, workflow or dataset already satisfies the need
prefer configuration, adapter, query, prompt, workflow or version activation before adding a new dependency
measure capability overlap and marginal gain
add a new tool only when it fills a verified gap or materially dominates the incumbent
record rejected duplicates and negative evidence to avoid repeated investigation
reuse_first.promotion_threshold: No production promotion without documented net capability gain, acceptable security and licensing, reproducible tests, and a rollback path. Popularity or novelty alone is insufficient.

incumbent_change_handling.compatible_addition: test the new operation or feature against existing contracts; promote only after regression and quota checks
incumbent_change_handling.behavior_change: run compatibility and evidence-diff tests; update adapters and documentation if safe
incumbent_change_handling.breaking_change: block automatic upgrade, generate migration plan, benchmark alternatives, and keep the last known-good pin
incumbent_change_handling.security_regression: block upgrade or disable the affected capability according to severity; search for a replacement
incumbent_change_handling.cost_or_license_regression: block promotion when free-gate or license rules fail; retain an approved free fallback
incumbent_change_handling.maintenance_decline: move to watchlist and trigger replacement search

coverage_controls.gap_driven_search: Search priority must be computed from uncovered or stale cells rather than fixed keyword rotation alone.

allowed: test execution in approved isolated workflows
forbidden: automatic installation of newly discovered code
automatic removal of the last known-good capability
